answer: A durable defense is stake that vests slowly: each agent locks refundable collateral that only matures as peers attest to honest work over many epochs. A fresh clone starts on the flat mesa of zero reputation and must climb the long ridge of accumulated history, paying real capital and time per identity, so a swarm of fakes never reaches the zenith where rewards flow. N aliases cost N times the bond, making sybil fleets scale linearly in cost, not for free.
